title: Proxmox host maintenance
summary: Assess a selected host, or explicitly authorize package maintenance and reboot only after guests are stopped or migrated.
requirements: Independent console access and verified backup/restore procedure
No running guests before package maintenance
Explicit maintenance and reboot authorization in private variables
Cluster quorum and workload placement reviewed outside this recipe
verification: Review assessment output before enabling maintenance
Confirm expected kernel, essential services and failed units
Validate storage, cluster state and guest workloads before restoring service
